create_c10d_logger: create a c10d-specific logger with debug-level logging and formatted output including process and thread names
get_logging_handler: get a logging handler from the registered handlers map by destination name
build_msg_dict: build a message dictionary with distributed context including func name, backend, world size, and rank information
test_exception_logger: test the _exception_logger decorator that catches exceptions, logs them with context, and re-raises
review_time_logger: review the _time_logger decorator that measures and logs function execution time in nanoseconds
